title: Bridging the Urban Divide: Adaptive Cross-City Learning for Disaster Sentiment Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating sentiment label distributions, prediction performance (accuracy, F1 scores), and correlations with physical mobility across urban versus non-urban and data-sparse cities.

Utilizing census-tract level demographic and socioeconomic indicators (e.g., income, housing, education) to model structural similarities between cities and assessing representational fairness for less-resourced communities.
